newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: 3Com announces 70 mln punt Irish expansion.
newsitem.headline: 3Com announces 70 mln punt Irish expansion.

text.p: 3Com Ireland, a manufacturer of computer network products, on Thursday announced a 70 million Irish pound expansion which will create 775 new jobs over the next five years.
The company said the expansion at its European facility in the Ballycoolin Business Park in Dublin would include manufacturing, research and development, sales and marketing.

3Com Ireland said in a statement that it planned to increase the manufacture of existing computer network products such as adapter cards and hubs. It said it would also assume world-wide responsibility for certain products.

The company manufactures adapters, hubs and ISDN routers for the European and world markets and has a research and development organisation which designs ASICS (Applications Scientific Integrated Circuits) for 3Com's hub product range.
